text:
jia: Quick sync — opened a PR to clarify tier attribution in the metering docs. It combines a compact SDK v4 snippet + a Grafana panel JSON for the usage dashboard. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123

matt: thanks, saw the PR. left 2 inline nits: (1) timestamps should be ISO, (2) show auth header example. otherwise neat and compact. :thumbsup:

elaine: agree with matt. Also recommend using 'breakdown' vs 'group_by' consistently in examples. matching the new API is important.

jia: copying a quick draft snippet here — open to wording: 

```python
# SDK v4 compact usage query (breakdown by tier)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="REDACTED")
resp = client.usage.query(
    start="2026-02-01T00:00:00Z",
    end="2026-03-01T00:00:00Z",
    breakdown="tier",
    filters={"product": "embedding-service"}
)
print(resp.metrics)
```

matt: looks better. can you include the header example? e.g. `Authorization: Bearer <KEY>` and an example curl variant so readers without the SDK can follow.

jia: added curl example below: 

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"start":"2026-02-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2026-03-01T00:00:00Z","breakdown":"tier"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage/query
```

sanjay: small doc note: mention that tiered credits are prorated per-second and rounded at charge time — saves tickets later. Add 1-2 lines under FAQ.

leo: I can supply a trimmed Grafana panel JSON for the docs. Use this panel query (stat panel) to show per-tier consumption. Jia, do you want me to paste the full JSON or a minimal snippet?

jia: minimal JSON please, just the 'targets' and 'title' so it fits in the docs.

leo: minimal panel JSON: 

```json
{"title":"Usage by tier","type":"stat","targets":[{"expr":"sum by (tier) (redwood_usage_tokens_total{product=\"embedding-service\"})","legendFormat":"{{tier}}"}]}
```

matt: nit: escape double quotes in the inline JSON example or wrap it as a code block — you're doing the latter so it's fine. Also add an internal grafana link for the example dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/usage-panels?view=tier

docs-bot: PR updated: jia pushed 2 commits to docs/metering-tier-sample at 5654322080 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123/files

jia: pushed changes: iso timestamps, header + curl, minimal grafana panel JSON, and a short FAQ line about prorating. PTAL @matt @leo @sanjay

product-qa: running a quick smoke on the examples now (validate curl + SDK snippet). will report back in ~10m.

product-qa: smoke passed: curl returns 200, SDK snippet executed in a fresh env, minimal grafana panel renders sample series locally. no regressions observed.

matt: LGTM. I'll approve and merge after CI finishes. Thanks for moving quickly.

jia: thanks everyone :rocket:
